CREATE TABLE "__EFMigrationsLock" (
    "Id" INTEGER NOT NULL CONSTRAINT "PK___EFMigrationsLock" PRIMARY KEY,
    "Timestamp" TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE "__EFMigrationsHistory" (
    "MigrationId" TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT "PK___EFMigrationsHistory" PRIMARY KEY,
    "ProductVersion" TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE "Contenidos" (
    "Id" INTEGER NOT NULL CONSTRAINT "PK_Contenidos" PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    "Titulo" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "Descripcion" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "Tipo" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "Genero" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "ClasificacionEdad" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "UrlStream" TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE "PasarelasPago" (
    "Id" INTEGER NOT NULL CONSTRAINT "PK_PasarelasPago" PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    "Nombre" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "UrlBase" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "ApiKey" TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE "Usuarios" (
    "Id" INTEGER NOT NULL CONSTRAINT "PK_Usuarios" PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    "Nombre" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "Email" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "PasswordHash" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "FechaRegistro" TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE "Suscripciones" (
    "Id" INTEGER NOT NULL CONSTRAINT "PK_Suscripciones" PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    "UsuarioId" INTEGER NOT NULL,
    "TipoPlan" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "FechaInicioPeriodo" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "Estado" TEXT NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT "FK_Suscripciones_Usuarios_UsuarioId" FOREIGN KEY ("UsuarioId") REFERENCES "Usuarios" ("Id") ON DELETE CASCADE
)
